title: SkillLens: An Interactive Human-LLM System for Diagnosing and Refining Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2611.28706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, yet maintaining them requires developers to connect revisions with changes in behavior and task outcomes. Existing workflows fragment evidence across versions, evaluation cases, and execution traces. We present SkillLens, an interactive human-LLM system for diagnosing and refining agent skills. A formative study with five developers and researchers identified challenges in prioritizing failures, reconstructing case-level evidence, and preserving context across revisions. SkillLens links performance changes, case transitions, skill diffs, invocation sequences, traces, and outputs in a recoverable workflow, while keeping model-generated explanations and refinements under human review. Through a between-subjects user study with 20 participants, we show that SkillLens supports developers in diagnosing and refining agent skills through a more usable and less demanding workflow than the baseli

translated_title: SkillLens：一个用于诊断与改进智能体技能的交互式人机协同系统
translated_abstract: LLM智能体越来越依赖可复用的技能，然而维护这些技能需要开发者将修订版本与行为变化和任务结果关联起来。现有的工作流程将证据分散在版本、评估用例和执行轨迹之中。我们提出了SkillLens，一个用于诊断和改进智能体技能的交互式人机协同系统。一项针对五名开发者和研究人员的形成性研究指出了在失败优先级排序、重建用例级证据以及跨修订版本保留上下文方面的挑战。SkillLens在一个可恢复的工作流程中将性能变化、用例转换、技能差异、调用序列、执行轨迹和输出结果关联起来，同时确保模型生成的解释和改进建议始终处于人工审查之下。通过一项包含20名参与者的被试间用户研究，我们展示了SkillLens通过比基线方法更可用、认知负担更低的工作流程，能够有效支持开发者诊断和改进智能体技能。
tldr: SkillLens是一个交互式人机协同系统，它将性能变化、用例转换、技能差异与执行轨迹等分散证据关联到可恢复的工作流程中，帮助开发者更高效地诊断和改进LLM智能体的可复用技能。
en_tdlr: SkillLens is an interactive human-LLM system that links fragmented evidence—performance changes, case transitions, skill diffs, and execution traces—into a recoverable workflow, enabling developers to diagnose and refine LLM agent skills more effectively with lower workload.
